function: p. 2-3: Channel estimation: FL-trained hierarchical networks (region classifier plus per-region estimators) map the received pilot signal to the cascaded BS-RIS-user channel of a downlink RIS-aided cell.
system: p. 2, 4: Downlink FDD single-cell; BS with M=16 (4x4) UPA antennas, reflecting RIS with N=64 (8x8) elements, R=3 regions with Kr=3 users each; frequency band not stated.
method: p. 3-4: Federated learning (parameters aggregated at the BS) of convolutional HNet and residual HReNet, each with a region classifier and per-region estimators; supervised training.
data_channel: p. 4: DeepMIMO O1 ray-tracing data, users in three regions (R100-R300, R500-R700, R900-R1100), 10000 samples per user; Section II models the channel as Saleh-Valenzuela (p. 2).
test_conditions: p. 4: 80% of the overall sample trains the model, same DeepMIMO regions throughout; NMSE swept over SNR; no new scenario, band, or array configuration is tested.
baselines: p. 4: Non-learned LS [20] and MMSE [5]; learned CL-based NN [9] and FL-based NN [11]; HNet and HReNet are compared with each other.
metrics: p. 4: NMSE in dB versus SNR (per region and whole cell); region-classification accuracy versus global rounds (Fig. 5); communication overhead of training.
complexity: p. 4: Parameter counts, PHNet = 2193536 versus PNN = 2171456 (1% more), and training communication overhead T_E = 6*PE*T*Kr; no FLOPs or runtime reported.
openness: none; only the public DeepMIMO dataset [21] is used (p. 4), and no code or data of its own is released
q1_support: p. 4: "Channel data for users in each region are generated based on the available DeepMIMO dataset" with ray-tracing scenarios; Section II (p. 2) writes a Saleh-Valenzuela model, but the data come from DeepMIMO.
q2_support: p. 4: "80% of the overall sample is devoted to model training", a split of the same DeepMIMO data and the same three regions; no other scenario, band, array size, or users are tested, and the SNR sweep does not count.
q3_support: p. 4: "LS algorithm [20], minimum mean squared error (MMSE) algorithm [5], CL-based NN [9], FL-based NN [11]"; p. 5: "improved by approximately 2.5 dB" over the CL-based NN in NMSE (Fig. 6).
q4_support: p. 4: "we have PNN = 2171456 and PHNet = 2193536", the number of parameters of the proposed HNet, with the formula for HReNet in (8).
q5_support: p. 4: "Channel data for users in each region are generated based on the available DeepMIMO dataset" [21], a public channel dataset; no code or data of its own is released.
notes: Included, area 2: FL only trains the channel estimator, with model parameters sent to the BS and aggregated digitally (p. 3), so it is not area 7. q1 and q5 rest on the DeepMIMO O1 scenario named on p. 4; the paper does not explain how the RIS cascaded channel is derived from it. q3: the NN baselines are attributed to refs [9] and [11] but are described as a nine-convolution-layer single network (p. 4), which a reviewer could read as an ablation of the proposed method. q4: the parameter counts are used to compute the FL training overhead (p. 4), which alone would not count, but the counts themselves are reported, so q4 is marked 1; the reviewer may want to confirm. Training targets are called the LS-estimator output on p. 4, while the dataset pairs on p. 2 are (y, G).
